pr_branches: tagging-profiles fix/profile-order-and-tags fix/ambiguous-artist-disambiguation feat/retry-import-failed feat/smaller-release-upgrades fix/release-imported-to-different-album feat/album-artist-credits fix/ignore-unmatched-download feat/fail-downloads feat/manual-interaction-notification feat/notification-links feat/import-list-clean-library feat/artist-alias-matching fix/artist-refresh-scan-scope feat/artist-alias-distance fix/feat-credit-keeps-version fix/qbittorrent-existing-torrent chore/frontend-dependency-advisories fix/log-cleansing-housekeeping-backups feat/custom-format-upgrades fix/unmapped-duplicates perf/database-queries perf/files-by-artist fix/cleanse-metadata-url-tokens fix/keep-unlisted-metadata feat/usenet-blocklist-same-indexer feat/plex-every-matching-library feat/interactive-search-history feat/download-client-fallback fix/undated-album-year feat/metadata-source-profiles feat/metadata-source-ids feat/deezer-metadata-source feat/discogs-metadata-source feat/discogs-disk-cache feat/metadata-supplementary-sources metadata-profile-must-not-contain
pr_shas__command: repo=$(jq -re '.pr_repo' < meta.json) && for branch in $(jq -re '.pr_branches' < meta.json); do sha=$(git ls-remote --exit-code "https://github.com/${repo}.git" "refs/heads/${branch}" | cut -f1) && [[ -n ${sha} ]] || exit 1; echo "${sha}"; done | paste -sd ' ' -
upstream_tag_sha__command: json=$(cat meta.json) && upstream_image=$(jq -re '.upstream_image' <<< "${json}") && upstream_image_base=$(basename "${upstream_image}") && upstream_tag=$(jq -re '.upstream_tag' <<< "${json}") && tags_json=$(curl -fsSL "https://hotio.dev/containers/${upstream_image_base}-tags.json") && commit_sha=$(jq -re --arg tag "${upstream_tag}" '.[$tag].commit_sha' <<< "${tags_json}") && upstream_tag_sha=${upstream_tag}-${commit_sha:0:7} && echo "${upstream_tag_sha}"
version__command: lidarr_sha=$(jq -re '.lidarr_sha' < meta.json) && pr=$(jq -re '.pr_shas' < meta.json | git hash-object --stdin) && major=$(curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$(jq -re '.lidarr_repo' < meta.json)/${lidarr_sha}/azure-pipelines.yml" | sed -n "s/^ *majorVersion: '\([0-9.]*\)'.*/\1/p") && test -n "${major}" && echo "${major}-${lidarr_sha:0:7}-${pr:0:7}"
